corinthians1.15.p1.b1.text: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, …

corinthians1.15.p1.b2.text: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that He was buried, …

corinthians1.15.p1.b3.text: … that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures, …

corinthians1.15.p2.b4.text: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.

corinthians1.15.p2.b5.text: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

corinthians1.15.p2.b6.text: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.

corinthians1.15.p2.b7.text: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.

corinthians1.15.p3.b8.text: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

corinthians1.15.p3.b9.text: But by the grace of God I am what I am, …

corinthians1.15.p3.b10.text: … yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

corinthians1.15.p3.b11.text: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.

corinthians1.15.p4.b12.text: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

corinthians1.15.p4.b13.text: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.

corinthians1.15.p4.b14.text: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.

corinthians1.15.p5.b15.text: … but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.

corinthians1.15.p5.b16.text: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

corinthians1.15.p5.b17.text: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

corinthians1.15.p5.b18.text: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.

corinthians1.15.p6.b19.text: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, …

corinthians1.15.p6.b20.text: … the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

corinthians1.15.p6.b21.text: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.

corinthians1.15.p6.b22.text: … Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.

corinthians1.15.p7.b23.text: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father …

corinthians1.15.p7.b24.text: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.

corinthians1.15.p7.b25.text: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.

corinthians1.15.p7.b26.text: … so that God may be all in all.

corinthians1.15.p8.b27.text: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

corinthians1.15.p8.b29.text: … If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

corinthians1.15.p8.b30.text: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; …

corinthians1.15.p9.b31.text: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”

corinthians1.15.p9.b32.text: … What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

corinthians1.15.p9.b33.text: … but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.

corinthians1.15.p9.b34.text: But God gives it a body as He has designed, …

corinthians1.15.p10.b35.text: Not all flesh is the same: …

corinthians1.15.p10.b36.text: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. …

corinthians1.15.p10.b37.text: The sun has one degree of splendor, …

corinthians1.15.p10.b38.text: … the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.

corinthians1.15.p11.b39.text: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: …

corinthians1.15.p11.b40.text: … What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.

corinthians1.15.p11.b41.text: … It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

corinthians1.15.p11.b42.text: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.

corinthians1.15.p12.b43.text: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.

corinthians1.15.p12.b44.text: As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; …

corinthians1.15.p12.b45.text: … and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.

corinthians1.15.p12.b46.text: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.

corinthians1.15.p13.b47.text: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—

corinthians1.15.p13.b48.text: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. …

corinthians1.15.p13.b49.text: … For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

corinthians1.15.p13.b50.text: … then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”

corinthians1.15.p13.b51.text: “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”

corinthians1.15.p14.b52.text: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

corinthians1.15.p14.b53.text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!

corinthians1.15.p14.b54.text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, …

corinthians1.15.p14.b55.text: … because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
